suggestions.title: Optimize Image Delivery
suggestions.description: Ensure the LCP image is optimized for size and loaded with high priority to reduce load time.
suggestions.implementation: Set image loading strategy using JavaScript adjustments to the attribute. Adjust width/height settings.

suggestions.title: Preload and Prioritize Critical CSS
suggestions.description: Reduce blocking CSS by splitting styles into critical and lazy-loaded, improving first-render time.
suggestions.implementation: Use HTTP Preload headers for key styles, and lazy-load less critical ones with conditional imports.

suggestions.title: Defer Third-party Scripts
suggestions.description: Convert blocking third-party scripts to asynchronous loading to prevent unnecessary blocking of main thread.
suggestions.implementation: Add 'defer' or 'async' attributes to third-party script tags where possible.

suggestions.title: Code Splitting and Unused Code Removal
suggestions.description: Identify unused code in large libraries and either remove or defer their loading to post-initial interactions.
suggestions.implementation: Implement tools for tree-shaking unused code, and split large modules to load conditionally.
